ai_summary: Amber Enterprises reported a fire at its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics, temporarily impacting operations at its Greater Noida factory and causing damage to property and inventory, though assets are adequately insured. A significant red flag is the tragic demise of two local fire authority personnel, alongside injuries to four others (one employee and three fire personnel), during firefighting operations. The company is currently assessing the full operational and financial impact and investigating the cause of the incident.
